desc:
🧠 Welcome to Brainrot Fusion, merging game where you combine random items to discover new brainrots! 
Can you unlock them all?

⚡ How to Play:
Merge different items together to create brand new brainrots!

🔥 WHAT’S NEW 🔥
   -   👦 Rockr Rockr Sahur
   -   🐔 Tirilikalika Tirilikalako
   -   📴  Nooo My Hotspot
   -   🌎 Il Mastodontico Telepiedone Planetario
   -   🐭Cacasito Satalito
   - Fixed a bug where if you merge brainrots to quickly then delete one, all gets deleted

5 New Brainrots added every week 

✨ FEATURES ✨
Hundreds of possible fusions to unlock!
Secret recipes and hidden brainrots waiting to be discovered.
A growing collection updated weekly!

💜 Make sure to JOIN THE GROUP for sneak peeks, and updates!
👍 Don’t forget to LIKE & FAVORITE the game if you’re enjoying it – it helps me keep adding more brainrot goodness!

❗ Note: I’m a solo developer, so please be patient with updates. If you find bugs, report them in the group, every bit of support means a lot!
